segments.text: نچہ ایدہ داشہ اسم بہا ہم,
this is not difficult for him to attain,
because Karnashakti Sodhanubhavat next Sutra.
Karnashakti is always found in each and every individual being
in his own experience of dreaming state and psychic state.
In psychic world also, you can do and undo.
When you are drunk, intoxicated with that wine or not mystic wine,
ordinary wine, liquor, then you think in yourself that you are Lord yourself.
No power can subside you.
It is your conception there.
Or when you enter in dreaming state,
in dreaming state also you can create and do and undo.
You can create motor car.
You can create road.
And motor car, you drive motor car on the road.
And that road is created by you and you are seated in motor car.
You are you.
And those trees around those on the sides of you,
of you in that lane or street are you.
Everything is you.
Somebody comes in front of you and stops your car.
That is you.
And you create the whole universe yourself.
Because there is no one else there created except your own glory.
So this way as Karnashakti is already found by every individual.
In the same way, his Karnashakti is universal.
Karnashakti of this yogi is universal.
His own experience in Sankal Pasopanadao, in psychic world or in dreaming state.
Karnashakti, doing and undoing, power of doing and undoing is there.
That is the essence of earth and earth.
To create world as you cannot create, as is not created in this wakefulness.
You can create your world of your own, by your own thought, power.
In this respect, in this respect also it is said.
So every individual being has got this power of knowing and creating, knowing and acting,
according to his choice of his thought.
Tathasambhavat, Yiddichaya-etat, when it is proved that Karnashakti is there already existing.
Yiddichaya-etat, God-abhinivation of Yumrasati, when he puts force of awareness in intense intensity of the desire.
And that desire will come true in wakefulness also.
Not only in dreaming state or in psychic state.
In wakefulness also, he can create worlds of his own.
Taddha, Sarvasaadha-rana, Sarvasaadha means those worlds which can be perceived by others too.
Others also can perceive his creation, in waking state.
Don't you understand?
Abhishta-arthin-yarmatrita, the abhishta-arthin-yarmatrita means he can create whatever he desires.
Outside, in outside world also.
It is said in Tattagarba also.
Yadat-u-thepi-suvyakt-sasam-marthi-guno-jala-bhavet-dredetara-dur-dhairita-dhairidinata-taddha-chitesham-sankalpa-pahadapadam-rache.
When those people who have got authority in dreaming state and psychic world,
those people also, when you rise to their samarthya, to their power of awareness,
and died in dinata, the liking of establishment of awareness, when it is thrown away,
liking of establishment of awareness.
When your awareness is not established properly, it lacks, it is not established.
Then it is thrown away, when it is kept away.
On the contrary, when your awareness is firm, it becomes firm.
Dada-dha-chitesham-sankalpa-pahadapadam-rache.
Then their desire becomes just like Kalpavreksha, the tree in heaven.
Whatever he desires, that comes true.
Whatever he thinks, that is true, just like Lord Shiva.
He becomes one with Lord Shiva.
